name: thin-overlay
assertion: Overlay references shared lifecycle and Action Log mechanics, contains only verified Total Recall differences, and never hardcodes active phase, model, CPU load or direct-trunk push authorization.

name: actual-cli-and-vault-boundary
assertion: Source checkout operations use node bin/total-recall.mjs where supported; vault mutations use CLI/API while ordinary docs/projects tracker edits remain documentation operations.

name: actual-test-coverage
assertion: Overlay names actual package/config gates and sanctioned background test host, distinguishing main Vitest exclusions from separately verified skill helpers and provider/deployment evidence.

name: shared-helper-delegation
assertion: Local overlay helpers delegate to the installed shared PM implementation and fail clearly when it is absent, rather than keeping duplicated stale or echo-only validation.
